objective.text: Add associations without detaching existing links.

difficulty.rationale: Apply additive assignment without removing existing membership or duplicating an existing link.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: An additive grant operation receives role IDs [2,3]. Role 2 may already be linked, and existing role 1 must remain. The pivot has a unique person/role pair. Which operation handles this request?

options.rationale: Blindly attaching role 2 can violate the unique pivot pair when it is already present.
options.misconception: Blindly attaching role 2 can violate the unique pivot pair when it is already present.

options.rationale: Full synchronization removes role 1 because it is omitted from the supplied set.
options.misconception: Full synchronization removes role 1 because it is omitted from the supplied set.

options.rationale: This retains existing associations, skips already present requested links and adds missing ones.
Toggle removes an already attached requested role, which is not additive grant behavior.
options.misconception: Toggle removes an already attached requested role, which is not additive grant behavior.
